instruction: Look at housing_simple.dxf. Draw the 160 x 100 housing outline as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with corners at (0,0), (160,0), (160,100), and (0,100). Draw a centered inner pocket rectangle on layer CUTOUT with opposite corners at (30,25) and (130,75). Draw two side port circles with radius 10 centered at (20,50) and (140,50) on layer HOLE, and add text ACAD-13 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
